brief:
Gadi Eisenkot, the retired general and political figure, is negotiating with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and the Likud party as part of broader talks with multiple political powers, Al Jazeera English reported. The negotiations provide Eisenkot with leverage in Israeli politics while simultaneously offering Likud renewed political relevance at a time when the party faces internal and external pressures.

The dual engagement reflects the complex Israeli political landscape, where opposition figures maintain channels with governing coalitions. Eisenkot's simultaneous discussions with different power centers strengthen his negotiating position across the political spectrum.
dek: Talks with different political powers give Yashar leverage. But they also give Likud renewed political relevance.
title: Eisenkot seeks leverage through talks with Netanyahu, Likud
